Usage: mcpjam cloud eval iterations [options]

List per-iteration results for an eval run (pass/fail, tool calls, tokens,
l

atency)

Options:
 --run <id> Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
 --project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaul
ts to the most recently\n updated project)\n --cursor <cursor> Pagination cursor from a previous r

esponse
 --limit <n> Max iterations per page (1–200)
 -h, --help display help for command
Usage: mcp

jam cloud eval gate [options] [command]

Apply a pass/fail policy to a finished eval run and set an exit code (0 pass or
waived

, 1 eval failure, 2 usage, 3 incomplete)

Options:
 --run <id> Eval run ID (from `eval run`)
--project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)\n --min-pass-rate
-percent <0-100> Minimum share of iterations that must pass, as a percentage\n --no-gating-score-errors
Fail if any required scorer errored during the run\n --min-scorer-pass-rate <scorerId=percent> Minimum pass rate for one sco
rer (repeatable) (default: [])\n --min-mean-score <scorerId=0..1> Minimum mean score for one scorer (repeatable) (defau
lt: [])\n --baseline <runId> Baseline run ID to gate a regression delta against; mutually exclusive with
--baseline-sha\n --baseline-sha <sha> Baseline source commit SHA, resolved to the completed run in this sui
te recorded against it; mutually exclusive with --baseline\n --min-sample-size <n> Iterations required on EA
CH side before a pass-rate regression is decidable (default 5); requires --baseline or --baseline-sha\n --min-effect-size-percent
<0-100> Smallest pass-rate drop worth failing on, as a percentage (default 1); requires --baseline or --baseline-sha\n
--gate-deterministic-regressions Fail if a deterministic required scorer flipped from passed to failed; requires --basel
ine or --baseline-sha\n --max-p95-latency-increase-ms <ms> Fail if p95 end-to-end latency rose by more than this many mil
liseconds vs the baseline; requires --baseline or --baseline-sha\n --max-cost-usd <usd> Fail if the run's M
CPJam-billed cost exceeded this many dollars; non-gateable when the run's cost is unknown or only partly measured\n --max-cost-in
crease-percent <percent> Fail if cost rose by more than this percentage of the baseline's; requires --baseline or --baseline-
sha\n --wait Poll until the run reaches a terminal status\n --wait-timeout <ms>
Give up waiting after this many milliseconds (default 600000; a run held for its judge gets up to 31 more minutes unles
s this flag is set)\n --reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Write a structured report to stdout instead of the default outpu
t\n --out <path> Atomically write the structured report selected by --reporter (default: json-summa
ry)\n --no-suite-policy Skip the stored suite quality-gate; evaluate only the flag/base report\n -h, --

help display help for command
